messages:
alice: Planning a quiet-cut window tonight 02:30 UTC. Goal: pin runtime v2.5.0 and api v1.9.0. Console change is a feature-flag flip only. Need router parity check for the new batching header order before we lock pins. @izzy @ben can you run a quick staging pass and report any KV handshake regressions? deploy-bot will do a dry-run.

deploy-bot: dry-run scheduled in 20m. Will enforce freeze 10m before window. /deploy preflight: no DB migrations, no infra changes.

izzy: Ran a quick smoke on staging. Generally OK but saw brief 502 bursts when runtime switched to the new batching path under burst load. Sample log: ```
2026-03-23T00:48:12Z WARN router: upstream 502 - header-order mismatch; expected [meta,flags,seq], got [flags,meta,seq]
stack: router.request -> router.proxy -> runtime.kv
```
Looks like header permutation from kernel reordering.

ben: Router note: the header parser in mainline expects fixed order. I can deploy a tolerant parser (accepts both orders) as a short-lived shim and canary it to one router shard. No schema changes needed.

alice: Rollback plan (concise): if error rate >1% sustained for 4m, rollback runtime to v2.4.x. If errors are only in router->runtime handshake and persist after runtime rollback, flip `router-tolerant-parser=true` and evaluate router rollback. If client-visible errors continue, roll api back to v1.8.x. Keep exec order: runtime -> router shim -> api. @oncall-sre confirm alerting?

oncall-sre: Affirm. I'll create an alert: 5xx rate >1% for 4m -> notify #incidents and page PD. Will add a small auto-traffic-shift runbook to divert a % of traffic to legacy runtime if we hit threshold.

console-eng: We'll add a banner during rollout and append the shim flag to release notes. Also adding a telemetry probe that posts a small header-order check via console path every 30s.

ben: Canarying parser shim to shard-3 now (1/1). Watching for p95 and 5xx. Will update in ~7m.

deploy-bot: dry-run complete. Canary started (1/1). Estimated full rollout 15m after green.

izzy: Canary shows error rate stable but p95 on hot KV rose ~45ms. No client 5xx so far. If p95 >250ms for 3m, mark for rollback.

alice: Locking pin window 02:30-03:00 UTC. No other pins allowed. Drafting release notes: "runtime v2.5.0 - batching kernel reorder; api v1.9.0 - relaxed header parsing; router - optional tolerant parser shim (auto-expire 45m)."

ben: Shim will auto-expire 45m after rollout. Tagging rollout metadata with `#tolerant-parser` and setting console probe check.

izzy: LGTM :white_check_mark:

oncall-sre: Pager on standby. I'll trigger runbook steps if alerts fire.

alice: Thanks team. Keep this thread for any rollout signals and rollback ops.
